crew.overview: A man wanders out of the desert not knowing who he is. His brother finds him, and helps to pull his memory back of the life he led before he walked out on his family and disappeared four years earlier.
crew.title: Paris, Texas

crew.overview: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. When Damiel falls in love with lonely trapeze artist Marion, the angel longs to experience life in the physical world, and finds -- with some words of wisdom from actor Peter Falk -- that it might be possible for him to take human form.
crew.title: Wings of Desire

crew.original_title: The Cook, the Thief, His Wife & Her Lover
crew.overview: The wife of an abusive criminal finds solace in the arms of a kind regular guest in her husband's restaurant.

details.biography: Pascale Dauman was a producer, and actress.  Pascale Dauman has produced movies such as "La Captive du désert", released in 1990, "The Cook the Thief His Wife & Her Lover"(1989), and "Der Himmel über Berlin"(1987).  As an actress, Pascale Dauman has also been seen in movies such as "Merry-Go-Round", released in 1981, in which she portrayed L'infirmière, "Hôtel du Paradis"(1986), and "Baisers volés"(1968).
details.name: Pascale Dauman
